newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering up as 1996 profit above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Schering up as 1996 profit above forecast.

text.p: Shares in German drugs group Schering AG rose strongly in pre-bourse trade on Tuesday as the group reported provisional 1996 net profit above expectations.
Schering shares, which had been stronger before the figures, stood 2.80 marks up at a new year-high of 147.20 after reporting provisional 1996 group net profit of 362 million marks.
Schering chief financial officer Klaus Pohle said in January that he expected net profit of about 330 to 340 million marks for 1996, a rise of more than 35 percent.
"That estimate has been significantly beaten," one Munich-based share dealer said.
